articles.author: Matt Egan
articles.title: Saudi Arabia cancels next week’s ‘Davos in the Desert’ conference after series of Houthi attacks - CNN
articles.description: In a major setback for the kingdom’s economic ambitions, Saudi Arabia has canceled a major conference scheduled for next week in Riyadh amid a wave of attacks by Iran-backed Houthi militants.
